notes.title: HeadHunters Steam Playtest — Live Now
notes.content:
[h1]Playtest is LIVE — jump in now![/h1][p]Thanks for helping us break (and improve) [b]HeadHunters[/b] — a chaotic platform-brawler where losing your head is just the start. Borrow a body, swing something ridiculous, and send your friends flying.[/p][p][/p][h2]What’s in this Playtest[/h2][list][*][p]Online matchmaking + private lobbies[/p][/*][*][p]Local couch play[/p][/*][*][p]A slice of stages, characters and weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Controller support (recommended)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]How to Join[/h2][olist][*][p]Open the [b]HeadHunters[/b] Steam page.[/p][/*][*][p]Click [b]Request Access[/b] under “Playtest.”[/p][/*][*][p]Download & play. No keys, no forms.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h2]Feedback we need[/h2][list][*][p]Balance (weapons, knockback, abilities)[/p][/*][*][p]Netcode stability & performance[/p][/*][*][p]UI/UX pain points
Post in [b]Steam Discussions → Playtest Feedback[/b] or use the in-game feedback prompt if you see it.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Timing[/h2][p][b]Live now through the weekend.[/b] We may extend the Playtest based on demand—watch this post for updates.[/p]
